desc: The DTNVS IPD stops are an optional add on to the ACTinBlack DTNVS. The DTNVS IPD stops allow the user to set the interpupillary distance on their DTNVS goggle so when the pods are articulated down they stop at the correct position set to the users eye. ACTinBlack IPD Stops are installable by the user and do not break purge or collimation.
